abstract: In this issue of Cancer Cell, Kehl et al. construct a single-cell atlas of bone marrow T cells from patients with bone marrow-resident malignancies, identifying tumor-reactive populations existing in a state of latent competence. A 15-gene signature identifies this subset, which is expanded by immunotherapies and predicts clinical responses.
